features.title: Start here
features.summary: Learn the order of work, from setting up your shop to checking the day’s money.

features.title: Sign in, join a shop and sign out
features.summary: Open your shop securely and leave it safely.

features.title: Overview and daily figures
features.summary: See bookings, billed amounts, payments and work waiting for your team.

features.title: Find a customer
features.summary: Reuse the right customer details and avoid selecting the wrong person.

features.title: Choose and read a report
features.summary: Answer a business question using saved figures and the records behind them.

features.title: Delivery performance report
features.summary: See which parcels were delivered and compare delivery against the expected time.

features.title: Create a booking
features.summary: Save the customer, parcels, price and billing details in one booking.

features.title: Set up a rate card
features.summary: Tell the app which destinations and services you sell, and what each weight band costs.

features.title: Set the GST treatment
features.summary: Choose the business GST treatment used automatically in booking totals.

features.title: Change business settings
features.summary: Save business preferences in clear sections. Some preferences are suggestions only.

features.title: Booking receipts and files
features.summary: View or print the saved booking receipt and attach supporting files.

features.title: Sales and GST
features.summary: See how much you billed, the saved tax amounts and later financial changes.

features.title: Pickup requests
features.summary: Agree a time to collect a customer’s parcel.

features.title: Packages
features.summary: Find parcels and record what has really happened to them.

features.title: Lots — parcel groups
features.summary: Keep parcels for the same destination together.

features.title: Routes and dispatch lists
features.summary: Plan a journey and keep its parcel list together.

features.title: Parcel handovers and custody
features.summary: Record who physically holds each parcel.

features.title: Delivery work
features.summary: Complete delivery using the recipient’s proof.

features.title: External e-way records
features.summary: Keep the details of an existing external document with a booking.

features.title: Automation and messages
features.summary: See whether shipment messages were queued, sent or delivered.

features.title: Messaging and assistant results
features.summary: Review a saved weekly count of messages, assistant outcomes and support work.

features.title: Human support
features.summary: Help customers and keep staff follow-up in one place.

features.title: Temporary agent access
features.summary: Allow a verified person to work as a delivery agent in this branch.

features.title: Owner summaries and alerts
features.summary: Get a regular business report and see overdue customer payments.

features.title: Customer accounts
features.summary: Keep monthly billing terms for a regular customer.

features.title: Customer statements
features.summary: See the bookings and payments included in a customer billing period.

features.title: Money received
features.summary: Record money that a customer has actually paid.

features.title: Expenses and fund requests
features.summary: Record what was paid and where money moved.

features.title: Cash locations
features.summary: Name the places or people that hold cash.

features.title: Handing over cash
features.summary: Record cash passed from one person or location to another.

features.title: Closing a cash drawer
features.summary: Compare counted cash with the cash records.

features.title: Agent money and seller COD
features.summary: Keep agent fees, agent advances and seller collections separate.

features.title: Agent daily statements
features.summary: Check an agent’s daily cash and saved money records.

features.title: Returning unused customer advance
features.summary: Record a request to return customer money that was not used for bills.

features.title: Shipment costs
features.summary: Record the purchase costs that belong to a shipment.

features.title: Revenue less shipment costs
features.summary: Compare selling revenue with the shipment costs recorded against it.

features.title: Checking bank records
features.summary: Compare imported bank entries with money already recorded in the app.

features.title: Approvals and refunds
features.summary: Review changes to booking charges and refund records.

features.summary: Give your accountant a saved set of financial records.

features.title: Outstanding balances by age
features.summary: See which unpaid balances have been waiting longest.
